warnings: ROI localization on ADNI relies on an automated SimpleITK rigid+affine registration of each volume to the MNI152 template (Mattes mutual information, no manual quality check of the registration result). This is research-grade, not clinically validated — unlike OASIS-1's T88 volumes, which ship pre-registered to Talairach-88 space by the dataset provider.

No CN/MCI/AD or CDR diagnostic labels exist for this cohort. Every session is stage='UNLABELED'. This dataset supports preprocessing and inference-only report generation against an already-trained checkpoint — never training, evaluation or ablation.
